title: Sealed forecasts against uniform on bench bans
xlabel: Mean log score minus uniform (nats per attempt not banned)
note_undefined_scored_as_uniform: An undefined forecast (fewer than 20 non-banned attempts, or no admissible nominee) is scored as uniform under the frozen rule, so a difference of 0 can mean the family was genuinely undefined on that event rather than tied with uniform. Ladder is defined on 1/5 gated events, Subtraction on 2/5, Proximity and Association on 5/5.

source.artifact_title: Forecasting where coding bans send a model
source.cross_check_file: results/analysis.json -> c1.mean_logscore_gated.<FAMILY> minus c1.mean_logscore_gated.UNIFORM reproduces mean_diff_vs_uniform to float precision
source.scoring_rule_file: src/score.py (docstring): 'Log score = mean over the ban's non-banned attempts of ln p(label) (natural log)', under a fixed 0.93/0.05/0.02 smoothing of each family's forecast toward uniform and an 'other' bucket
source.ci_method: task-cluster bootstrap, 95% interval, over the 5 gated events (results/posthoc_sensitivity.json note (2))
source.gated_task_definition: avoidance >= 0.5 and >= 20 non-banned attempts (README.md line 77); 5 of the task's 12 modal bans pass this gate
source.verified: all four point values and both CI bounds for all four families read back from the artifact's own output files and matched to the figure specification to 4 decimal places; defined_n/defined_total matched exactly
